deferred_platforms.reason: CVF-107 is the opt-in Windows-only hardware suite. Its evidence cannot be produced by a deterministic Linux gate and the contract forbids registering the target with CTest or any hosted CI job. The hardware execution was performed manually on a designated Windows 11 station against a YLX-4K-S858 UVC camera and is recorded in .ai/reports/CVF-107-hardware.yaml with raw console logs under .ai/validation/cvf107-hardware-evidence/.

The change touches only tests/hardware/**, docs/**, and the target-scoped MSVC definition in CMakeLists.txt. No production module changes, so the portable suite is the authoritative deterministic gate here. The msvc build of the hardware target was performed on the station (exit 0) and is recorded in the hardware report.
